household_message.text: Long trip tomorrow, leaving really early. Make sure the car is full.

message_to_household: I will charge the car to 100 % by 07:30 tomorrow morning, using solar power and the battery when available. If the weather forecast shows enough solar, I will not need to use grid power at all.

questions.text: Your usual ready-by time is 07:30 tomorrow. Is this still okay for your trip, or should I charge by a different time?
Your usual charge target is 80 %. Is "full" (100 %) really needed for your trip?
